_doc: The model taxonomy's vocabulary: each model has one category, its shelf, any tags, terms grouped by facet, and any keywords. Every category, facet term and keyword carries its one-line meaning. Why tags are semi-closed and keywords open by review, and how a term is requested and added, is in models/TAXONOMY.md.

categories.ammunition: Cartridges, rounds, shells, spent cases and the boxes and cans made to hold them.
categories.arcana: Magical and occult objects: wands, rune tablets, charms, ritual gear.
categories.armour: Protective wear and shields: helmets, armoured vests, plate, powered armour.
categories.body-parts: Bodies and pieces of them that are not animated actors: the player's body parts, severed limbs, remains.
categories.clothing: Garments, headwear, footwear and gloves worn for cover, warmth or style rather than protection.
categories.containers: Things made to hold other things: cans, bottles, boxes, crates, bags, backpacks, fuel cans.
categories.creatures: Animated generated actors with a body and pose clips: creatures, the undead, the player.
categories.documents: Written and printed matter: notebooks, books, notes, letters, maps, signs to read.
categories.electrical: Powered devices and their components: radios, batteries, wire, fuses, appliances, gadgets.
categories.food: Food and drink, fresh or packaged, sealed, opened or emptied.
categories.furniture: Furnishings: seats, tables, beds, mattresses, shelves, cabinets, lockers.
categories.household: Domestic utensils and small household objects: kitchenware, cleaning gear, decor.
categories.keys: Keys, keycards and other tokens that open a lock or a door.
categories.lighting: Light sources and fire starters: torches, lamps, candles, flashlights, lighters, matches.
categories.machinery: Workshop and industrial machines and engines: compressors, presses, stationary saws, furnaces, generators.
categories.materials: Raw and crafting materials and loose hardware: planks, sticks, nails, tape, cord, wax, scrap, hinges.
categories.medical: Medicine and first aid: drugs, bandages, antiseptics, medical instruments.
categories.nature: Natural objects as found: rocks, plants, logs, shells, bones lying loose.
categories.recreation: Toys, games, sports gear and musical instruments.
categories.structures: Building elements and fixtures: walls, doors, windows, fences, barriers, signs on posts.
categories.tools: Hand and power tools carried to do work: hammers, saws, axes, pliers, jacks, repair kits.
categories.vehicle-parts: Parts and fittings of vehicles: shells, panels, doors, glass, wheels, axles, engines, seats, lamps.
categories.weapon-parts: Pieces of weapons and their accessories: magazines, receivers, barrels, stocks, sights, suppressors, slings, mounts.
categories.weapons: Whole weapons: firearms, melee weapons, explosives and traps.

fit.meaning: How a worn model is shaped: as worn on the shared player body rather than lying loose. A loose model has no fit.

terms.worn: Shaped to sit on the shared player body.
terms.over-jacket: Shaped to sit over a jacket on the shared player body, a second layer.

material.meaning: The one or two materials the model mostly reads as, not every material in it.

terms.fabric: Woven or knitted cloth, felt, rope and cord.
terms.metal: Any metal: steel, iron, bronze, copper, aluminium, gold.
terms.plant: Unworked plant matter: leaves, straw, bark, reed, fibre.

place.meaning: Where the model is typically found; a model found in several places names each.

terms.bathroom: A bathroom or washroom: toilets, basins, baths, toilet brushes, towels, soap.
terms.farm: A farm: tools and equipment for crops and livestock, feed, harvest gear.
terms.gym: A gym or fitness centre: training equipment, gym bags, mats.
terms.hospital: A hospital or surgery: beds, drips, medical and surgical equipment.
terms.kitchen: A kitchen: cookware, utensils, crockery and food-preparation appliances.
terms.laboratory: A laboratory: glassware, lab instruments and sample containers.
terms.office: An office: desks, stationery, filing and office machines.
terms.workshop: A workshop or garage: workbenches, vises, machine and hand tools.

setting.meaning: The era or genre a model belongs to. Untagged reads as no particular setting.

terms.prehistoric: Stone-age making: knapped stone, digging sticks, lashed hafts.
terms.ancient: Classical and bronze-age antiquity: bronze arms, Greek and Roman gear.
terms.medieval: The middle ages and other pre-gunpowder feudal settings: plate, mail, kite shields.
terms.modern: The present day, from roughly the twentieth century: the everyday world.
terms.sci-fi: Future technology: powered armour, energy weapons, starship gear.
terms.fantasy: Magic and myth: wands, enchanted gear, wizard dress.

slot.meaning: Where on the body the model is worn; a worn set's pieces each name the part they cover.

terms.head: On the head: hats, helmets, hoods, circlets.
terms.face: Over the face or eyes: masks, goggles, visors.
terms.neck: Round the neck: scarves, collars, necklaces.
terms.torso: On the trunk: shirts, jackets, vests, body armour.
terms.arms: On the upper or lower arms: sleeves, bracers.
terms.waist: At the waist or hips: belts, waist packs.
terms.legs: On the hips and legs: trousers, leg guards.
terms.feet: On the feet: shoes, boots and their shafts.
terms.back: On the back or slung over a shoulder: backpacks, slings, quivers.

state.meaning: A condition a model shows that sets it apart from the plain, whole object.

terms.abandoned: Left to decay: weathered, rusted, flat tyres, broken glass.
terms.crashed: Damaged by a crash or collision but still whole: crumpled, jackknifed.
terms.wrecked: A total wreck, beyond repair: stripped, torn apart or burnt to the frame, not just damaged.
terms.broken: Broken or dead and no longer working.

vehicle-body.meaning: The body or airframe type of the vehicle a model is or belongs to.

terms.car: Cars: hatchbacks, saloons, estates, coupés, SUVs and 4x4s.
terms.truck: Lorries and trucks with a cab: box, flatbed, tipper, tanker, tractor units.
terms.trailer: Trailers and caravans, towed rather than driven.
terms.plant: Self-propelled work machines: tractors, excavators, forklifts, rollers, skid steers, combines, trenchers.
terms.armoured: Armoured fighting and patrol vehicles: APCs.

vehicle-role.meaning: The service or work the vehicle a model is or belongs to is built for, whatever its body.

terms.emergency: Ambulance, fire, police and rescue service.
terms.farm: Farm work: tractors, harvesters, livestock trailers.
terms.construction: Construction and heavy plant: excavators, cranes, rollers, forklifts.
terms.utility: Municipal and utility service: street cleaning, refuse collection, recovery, line work, animal control.

weapon.meaning: The weapon class a model is or serves, so a class finds its weapons, parts and ammunition together.

terms.energy: Weapons that fire energy or plasma rather than solid rounds.
terms.blade: Edged weapons that cut or stab: knives, swords, machetes.
terms.blunt: Weapons that strike: bats, clubs, maces, pipes.
terms.polearm: Weapons on a long shaft: spears, poles, halberds.
terms.trap: Traps set to catch or wound.

keywords.alchemy: Alchemical and apothecary apparatus: alembics, retorts, athanors, phials, sand and water baths.
keywords.appliance: Domestic electrical appliances, large or small: fridges, ovens, washing machines, toasters, heaters.
keywords.archery: Gear for shooting a bow: quivers, bow slings, targets.
keywords.camping: Gear for camping and backpacking: tents, shelters, sleeping bags, camp stoves, cots, frame packs.
keywords.cardio: Equipment for cardiovascular training: treadmills, rowers, exercise bikes.
keywords.cleaning: Things used to clean a home: brooms, mops, sponges, plungers, scrubbing brushes.
keywords.cold-weather: Made to keep warm in the cold: winter coats, mittens, thermals, balaclavas, heaters, heat packs.
keywords.computer: Computers, their parts and their storage: laptops, tablets, processors, memory, drives.
keywords.cooking: Used to cook or prepare food: pots, pans, stoves, cookers, kitchen utensils and appliances.
keywords.costume: Fancy dress and dress-up: Santa, clown, ghost and animal outfits, horns, halos, fake fangs.
keywords.diving: Gear for diving and underwater work: wetsuits, fins, diving masks, dive bags.
keywords.duffel: A soft cylindrical bag with carry handles, carried in the hand or over a shoulder.
keywords.elemental: Creatures made of an element: fire, water, storm.
keywords.fire-starting: Used to start a fire: lighters, matches, fire pistons, bow drills, flint and steel, ember carriers.
keywords.firefighting: Firefighters' gear and kit: turnout coats, fire helmets, extinguishers, halligans, flame-resistant wear.
keywords.fitness: General fitness training: light weights, mats, cardio machines.
keywords.formalwear: Formal dress and its accessories: suits, tuxedos, gowns, dress shirts, ties, cufflinks.
keywords.free-weights: Weights lifted free rather than on a machine: dumbbells, kettlebells, barbells, plates.
keywords.fuel: Fuel and its containers: jerrycans, propane tanks, gas canisters, fuel drums.
keywords.gardening: Used for garden and yard work: rakes, hoes, trowels, hedge trimmers, mowers, flower pots.
keywords.hygiene: Personal care and grooming: toothbrushes, combs, razors, shaving kits, hair dryers, toilet paper.
keywords.improvised: Made from scrap or whatever was to hand rather than built for the job: makeshift tools, scrap and tyre armour, pipe guns.
keywords.insect: Insects and insect-like creatures: giant roaches, ant queens.
keywords.jewellery: Jewellery and personal adornment: rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets, anklets, piercings, crowns.
keywords.luggage: Bags and cases for travel: suitcases, garment bags, travel packs, briefcases, duffel bags.
keywords.martial-arts: Martial arts and combat sport wear and gear: gis, belts, sparring headgear, mouthguards.
keywords.metalworking: Used to work metal: anvils, forges, tongs, swages, files, welders, metal presses.
keywords.military: Military issue or military style: combat uniforms, plate carriers, load-bearing vests, military packs.
keywords.music: Musical instruments and gear for playing or recording music: instruments, stands, microphones, amplifiers.
keywords.painkiller: Relieves pain: analgesic tablets, opioids, numbing creams and ointments.
keywords.police: Police and law-enforcement gear: badges, duty belts, riot armour and helmets.
keywords.radiation: Detects, measures or protects against radiation: Geiger counters, dosimeter badges, iodide tablets, sealed suits.
keywords.recreational-drug: Drugs taken for their effect rather than as medicine, and their paraphernalia: cannabis, cocaine, pipes.
keywords.religious: Religious vestments and ritual objects: prayer shawls, tefillin, monastic robes, habits, holy symbols.
keywords.safety-gear: Personal protective equipment for work: hard hats, safety glasses, ear defenders, cut-resistant and chemical protection.
keywords.scope: A magnifying optical sight for a gun.
keywords.sewing: Used for sewing, tailoring and needlework: needles, thread, pinking scissors, pattern sets.
keywords.silencer: A suppressor that muffles a gun's report.
keywords.strength-training: Equipment for building strength: weights, benches, racks, machines.
keywords.swimming: Swimwear and swimming gear: swimsuits, trunks, swim caps, goggles, fins, float vests.
keywords.tobacco: Tobacco and nicotine products and their use: cigarettes, cigars, rolling tobacco, nicotine gum, vapes, pipes.
keywords.toy: Toys and playthings: dolls, plushies, figurines, remote-control cars, yo-yos, dice.
keywords.undead: Anything dead that still moves, zombie or not: zombies, bog bodies, death knights, skeletons, ghosts.
keywords.underwear: Underwear and base layers: briefs, boxers, bras, undershirts, corsets, long underwear, tights.
keywords.water-purification: Makes water safe to drink: purifiers, filters, filter straws, rain catchers.
keywords.woodworking: Used to work wood: table saws, planers, jointers, hand saws, chisels, clamps.
keywords.zombie: Reanimated corpses that shamble, run or crawl at the living: shamblers, runners, crawlers, fused masses.
